purpose: Reference inventory for bounded world-fit UI review generation; this file grants no runtime, design-language, or acceptance authority.

used_references.role: host-world context and primary composition reference
used_references.selection_reason: Shows the recognizable lavender-brick Stuffie Playroom, broad calm painted floor, cream columns, aqua windows, and modest shell marks around a usable center.
used_references.source_and_consumer: Logical v4 room background plate. The current Castle v4 manifest routes Playroom background ownership through the native tile family loaded by scripts/arena/castle_rooms_25d.gd; this plate is a comparator, not a runtime capture or sole-texture claim.

used_references.role: other indoor/career-world painted-form and object-craft reference
used_references.selection_reason: Balances richly illustrated brushes, paint vats, coral, shell accents, paths, and water without making every object a jeweled control.
used_references.source_and_consumer: Career-world painting family. scripts/opera_world_backdrop_2d.gd dynamically constructs world_%s.png and prefers available world tiles before falling back to the painting. Accepted native source and generation record live under assets_src/imagegen/opera_codex_2026-08-02/.

used_references.role: outdoor whole-frame matte-surface and quiet-space reference
used_references.selection_reason: Shows the broad sky, meadow, path, foliage framing, and atmospheric separation needed to prevent an indoor pause style from becoming a theatrical world replacement.
used_references.source_and_consumer: Historical reductive full-composition reference plate, not the current Sky v5 master or runtime authority. The current approved source is assets_src/sky_lagoon/masters/sky_lagoon_panorama_master_v5_hd_3x1.png and runtime uses its 6x2 tile family. This limitation remains visible for human review.

used_references.role: existing painted object-construction reference for the new Sticker scrapbook
used_references.selection_reason: Provides substantial pages, cover thickness, clasp, painted shading, and shell-world material cues without supplying Sticker-route identity pixels.
used_references.source_and_consumer: Existing Castle library object art. Used only for material and construction reference; its pixels are not copied into the candidate and it does not become the Sticker route icon.

used_references.selection_reason: Establishes that the route belongs to care and play in the Stuffie room. The generated symbol deliberately uses a basket, blanket, heart patch, and brush instead of any face or friend likeness.
used_references.source_and_consumer: Existing Playroom object art. No pictured plush/friend identity is authorized, accepted, or copied by this reference use.

inventoried_not_bound.disposition: Inspected but removed from the successful generation reference set because built-in image_gen accepts at most five paths and a fixed house/hall crest could falsely imply one universal Leave destination.
Inventoried but not bound. These are character/identity stickers, while the pause route needs an authored Sticker-book object symbol without implying one character is the route.
Inventoried but not bound. Animation atlases are actor art, not a Critter-book route symbol; the candidate instead depicts a richly painted field guide.
Inventoried but not bound because the isolated layer art does not meet this review's requested high-detail object-illustration bar for a new menu concept. Existing runtime ownership is unchanged.

reference_limit_event.reason: A proposed six-reference call was rejected because referenced_image_paths accepts at most five paths.
